pages.text: After obtaining $(l:goetymech_crafts/twisted_embryo)Twisted Embryos$(/l), you began exploring ways to convert them into combat power more efficiently.$(br)Eventually, you found inspiration in the traditional training methods of the illagers, and through dark magic, you established a connection between this furnace and an $(l:crafts/artifice/ominous_pyre)Ominous Pyre$(/l).

Once placed, the furnace will automatically bind to any Ominous Pyre within 8 blocks. After binding, Twisted Embryos can be input through hoppers.$(br)After a period of cooking, the embryo will transform into a Mature Embryo matching the entity type set on the bound Pyre.$(br)Spend a bit of soul energy to convert the embryo into your soldier.$(br)Used together with the Squad Barracks and Squad Focus, you can organize an army more efficiently.$(br)$(4)"Twisted flesh creations... I can vaguely sense that these remains hold deeper secrets waiting to be explored, but that has strayed beyond the realm of magic."$()
